syllabus: There being no error the judgment is affirmed.
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF GEORGIA.
attorneys: Mr. 3. W. Johnston and Mr. Joseph P. Carr for plaintiff in error., No appearance for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Chase
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Chase

delivered the opinion of the court.

We find no error in the record.

The judgment of the Supreme Court of Georgia is, therefore,

Affirmed.
